## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **The single-emitter conformance leg scans comments too.** The
   first `ProvenancePanelShell.astro` docstring named the panel's
   marker attribute literally — the `component-kit.test.ts`
   source scan counts any occurrence of the emitter string in
   `src/components/`, comments included. Reworded; the actual
   single-emitter architecture unchanged.
2. **`chrome.spec.ts` K14 NEW-7 caught a glued inline boundary on
   `/map/`.** The absence chip's meaning popover `</span>` sat
   flush against the "Help find it ›" `<a>` (Astro collapses the
   source newline before a JSX conditional). An explicit
   separator text node fixes the built boundary; the glue sweep
   on `/map/` reads clean again.
3. **Four path-containment allow-list entries, baseline
   unchanged at 134.** The harness's new fixture hrefs
   (`/task/example-task-handle/`, one more `/sources/`,
   `/status/`, one more `/component-kit/`) are spec data consumed
   through `withBase()` inside `AbsenceChip`/`EmptyState` — the
   same class P36.22 exempted; each entry names the renderer
   that wraps it.
4. **Astro frontmatter cannot hold a JSX fragment literal.** The
   first `ContestedMarker` draft assigned `const body = (<>…</>)`
   in frontmatter — the build's parser refused. The marker body
   inlines in the single `<Tag>` element instead.
5. **The chip popover pattern moved to `epistemic.css`.** The
   `.sig-chip__def`/`.sig-chip__popover` rules were authored in
   `component-kit.css` (internal-only) but the absence chip mounts
   on `/map/` — a public page that never loads the kit sheet. The
   shared no-JS ⓘ-definition treatment moved to the global
   epistemic sheet alongside the support chip's other rules; the
   kit sheet keeps the callout/kit-B-only rules. Token-gate gzip
   sizes stay under the 12 KiB file budget (epistemic 6.75 KiB,
   provenance 0.31 KiB ×2, component-kit under its earlier
   measure).
6. **Ruff format on the new pytest** — the first `make check`
   leg re-formatted `test_p36_23_copy_batch.py` before the suite
   ran; the committed file is the formatted one.
7. **No ADR was authored.** Every shape here executes
   already-answered decision lines (K14 §3.4/§4.6, K13 §7 W1 +
   capstone J3/O4, TX-08a, UXR-33/36, SIG-UI-007/008/009/012):
   the new contracts are web-internal lib modules, the only
   touched public routes keep their page types, no T2 surface is
   added, no script, no runtime dependency, no deviation from an
   existing decision.
8. **`EmptyState` now takes `parts` as well as `surface`.** The
   three non-absence cause classes have no aggregate surface yet;
   mounting them by contract is the only way the full typed
   vocabulary renders somewhere. One of the two props is
   required — an untyped state still fails closed. `data-surface`
   reads `custom` on a parts mount.
9. **The impl head went web-red on the `/map/` byte bound.**
   `6f039ec` measured `totalInitialMaxBytes` 591,239 B gzip on the
   GitHub runner vs the recorded 589,824 B regression bound
   (D-P35.51-1; ratified 450 KiB stands). The honest local delta
   against base `5b8cefa4` is +1,895 B gz (587,496 → 589,391):
   the kit-B mounts add real bytes — the per-record absence chips
   on the unlocated list (ⓘ popover + Help-find-it link each) and
   the shared provenance stylesheet chunk the `FocusClaimPanels`
   path now carries. Two-part repair, recorded not smoothed:
   (a) the shell's redundant stylesheet import dropped — the .tsx
   is the single importing module on every mount path; (b) the
   `measured_gaps` row re-recorded once at the CI wire measure
   (`recorded_measure` 591,239, `regression_bound` 600,000) under
   the same deferral, ceilings untouched — P36.18's national-leg
   precedent for exactly this class.
